subjects.description: A fallen tree limb, thick and gnarled, with rough dark-brown bark and clusters of green leaves still attached, lying diagonally across the right side of the roadway
subjects.appearance_details: Splintered break point at the base, scattered twigs and torn foliage around it, wet from recent rain with darkened bark
subjects.relationship: A road hazard directly in the ego vehicle's path, connected to the downed power line it pulled with it
subjects.location: Center-right of frame, ahead on the road surface
subjects.orientation: Lying diagonally across the lane, angled from the right shoulder toward the center
subjects.action: Lying motionless across the right lane
subjects.state_changes: Grows larger and nearer as the vehicle approaches.

subjects.description: A thin black power line, pulled down by the fallen limb, drooping low across the full width of the road at roughly hood height
subjects.appearance_details: A slender dark cable sagging in a shallow catenary curve, glistening faintly with moisture, nearly blending with the overcast gray background
subjects.relationship: Connected to and pulled down by the fallen tree limb; the primary unperceived hazard directly in the vehicle's path
subjects.location: Spanning the full width of frame at mid-height, ahead of the vehicle
subjects.orientation: Horizontal, stretched across the road perpendicular to travel direction
subjects.pose: Sagging low in a gentle downward curve
subjects.action: Hanging motionless across the road at hood height
subjects.state_changes: Appears thin and hard to see, growing closer and slightly more visible as the vehicle nears, then rushing toward the camera.

subjects.description: The ego vehicle, a passenger car whose interior and hood are implied by the first-person driving perspective
subjects.appearance_details: Front hood edge faintly visible at the bottom of the frame, wet windshield with occasional water beads, dashboard reflections implied
subjects.relationship: The point-of-view subject whose perception system fails to detect the thin power line
subjects.location: Camera position; hood at bottom foreground
subjects.pose: Driving forward in a straight line
subjects.action: Cruising forward at normal speed without slowing
subjects.state_changes: Maintains constant speed throughout, no braking or deceleration.

background_setting: A quiet two-lane suburban road in the aftermath of a storm. The asphalt is dark and wet, reflecting the muted gray sky, with shallow puddles and scattered debris. Lined by residential lawns, mailboxes, and rows of leafy trees, some bent and shedding branches. A faded double-yellow centerline runs down the road. Overcast skies hang heavy and colorless overhead, and the atmosphere is damp and still with the storm just passed.

lighting.direction: Diffuse, top-down ambient light with no distinct source
lighting.shadows: Soft, faint, and diffuse; almost no hard shadows on the wet pavement
lighting.illumination_effect: Flat, even, desaturated illumination that reduces contrast and makes the thin power line hard to distinguish against the gray backdrop

aesthetics.composition: Centered one-point perspective down the road, hood edge anchoring the bottom, fallen limb on the right, and the power line spanning horizontally at mid-frame height
aesthetics.color_scheme: Muted grays, wet-asphalt charcoal, dark greens of foliage, and brown bark under a colorless sky
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating roadside trees and lane markings receding into the distance

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward tracking shot following the vehicle's motion, steady dashcam-style; the vehicle never brakes or slows, holding a constant speed through the final frame
cinematography.camera_angle: Eye-level, low mounted at windshield height
cinematography.focus: Sharp on the road ahead, the fallen limb, and the road surface

context: Autonomous vehicle perception failure scenario depicting a car failing to detect a low-hanging downed power line

actions.description: The ego vehicle cruises forward along the wet suburban road; the fallen tree limb and drooping power line become visible ahead. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The vehicle continues at constant speed toward the hazards without slowing. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The vehicle drives straight into the thin power line at cruising speed, the line rushing toward and across the windshield. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

temporal_caption: At 0:00, the dashcam view shows a wet, overcast two-lane suburban road with a faded centerline and puddle-strewn asphalt reflecting the gray sky. By 0:01, a fallen tree limb becomes visible across the right side of the lane, and a thin black power line droops low across the full width of the road at about hood height. From 0:02 to 0:03, the ego vehicle continues at its normal cruising speed with no braking, the limb looming on the right and the barely visible line stretched ahead. From 0:03 to 0:05, the vehicle drives straight into the thin power line, which rushes toward and across the windshield as the car makes contact without slowing or stopping. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
audio_description: Ambient post-storm soundscape: the steady hum of tires on wet pavement, occasional water spray, faint wind, and dripping foliage. No music. A soft whoosh and a sharp snapping crack as the vehicle strikes the power line near the end.
